description: This source file defines the ChangeLogDetective class, which is responsible for determining the initial Liquibase snapshot version used to initialize an OpenMRS database, identifying un-ran change sets, and managing Liquibase update files. It includes functionality for querying Liquibase change logs, filtering vintage change sets, and logging details about un-ran change sets.

classes.name: ChangeLogDetective
classes.description: Manages detection of which Liquibase change logs were used during database initialization and which need to be run during updates.

methods.name: getInitialLiquibaseSnapshotVersion
methods.description: Determines the Liquibase snapshot version used to initialize the database by checking un-ran change sets across known snapshot versions.

methods.name: getUnrunLiquibaseUpdateFileNames
methods.description: Returns list of update files with un-ran change sets for a given snapshot version and context.

methods.name: getSnapshotVersionsInDescendingOrder
methods.description: Sorts snapshot version strings in descending order.

methods.name: excludeVintageChangeSets
methods.description: Filters out vintage change sets based on specific criteria.

methods.name: getUnrunChangeSets
methods.description: Fetches un-ran change sets from Liquibase for a specific file and context.

methods.name: isVintageChangeSet
methods.description: Determines whether a change set is vintage based on filename and change set attributes.

methods.name: logUnRunChangeSetDetails
methods.description: Logs details of un-ran change sets, limited to a maximum count.
